narrative.overview: KuriPro is an account book that fits in an organizer's pocket. It is used on a mid-range Android phone, often away from a desk, so every screen has to feel exact before it feels pretty. Numbers read first; chrome stays quiet; violet marks what can be acted on.
keyCharacteristics: Violet is the single accent; green, amber and red are reserved for payment state.
Hairline borders and white paper carry structure; shadow is a whisper at rest.
44px minimum touch targets; 16px input text on phones.
Tabular numerals for every amount; INR with lakh grouping.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only decorative color. Green, amber and red mean payment state and nothing else.

rules.name: The Number-First Rule
rules.body: On any money screen the amount is the largest, highest-contrast element, in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every amount, count and date column uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Stronger shadow belongs to overlays.

dos: Do use violet only as the accent, and reserve green/amber/red for payment state.
Do show amounts as INR with lakh grouping in tabular figures, largest on the screen.
Do keep every tappable target at least 44px and give it press feedback.
Do use Strong Paid Green for green text and for solid green buttons.
donts: Don't convey state with color alone; pair it with a label or icon.
Don't use Mist, plain Paid Green or Pending Amber as small text on white.
Don't put heavy shadows on ordinary cards or add more than one gradient hero per screen.
Don't hard-code colors: use the CSS variables so light and dark both work.
